{{nihongo|'''Shirahige Shrine'''|白鬚神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

'''Shirahige Shrine''' (しらひげじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Sunomata, Sunomata-chō, {{ill|Ōgaki|Q384926|qid=Q384926}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}.

It is one of the {{ill|Shikinai Ronsha|Q135022904|qid=Q135022904}} for Arakata Shrine (Arakata Myōjin), a shikinaisha in {{ill|Anpachi District, Gifu|Q1204320|qid=Q1204320}}, {{ill|Mino Province|Q864156|qid=Q864156}}. The other candidate shrine is {{ill|Sunomata Hachiman Shrine|Q11391073|qid=Q11391073|lt=Hachiman Shrine}}.

Its original location is said to have been on the riverbed of the current {{ill|Sai River (Gifu)|Q7399814|qid=Q7399814|lt=Sai River}}, on the boundary between {{ill|Motosu District, Gifu|Q1204331|qid=Q1204331}} and Anpachi District.

=== Overview ===
*It is located north of {{ill|Sunomata Castle|Q1036473|qid=Q1036473}}, and the precinct is part of Ichiyajō-ato Park.
*There is Toyokuni Shrine as a precinct shrine. It was divided from {{ill|Hōkoku Shrine (Osaka)|Q704855|qid=Q704855|lt=Toyokuni Shrine}} in {{ill|Osaka Castle Park|Q150118|qid=Q150118}} when the imitation {{ill|Tenshu|Q49144|qid=Q49144|lt=castle tower}} ({{ill|Sunomata Local History Museum|Q115112030|qid=Q115112030}}) of Sunomata Castle was built. While the deities of Osaka’s Toyokuni Shrine are {{ill|Toyotomi Hideyoshi|Q187550|qid=Q187550}}, {{ill|Toyotomi Hideyori|Q313641|qid=Q313641}}, and {{ill|Toyotomi Hidenaga|Q1191183|qid=Q1191183}}, only Hideyoshi was enshrined in this branch shrine.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* {{ill|Sarutahiko Ōkami|Q3090037|qid=Q3090037|lt=Sarutahiko Ōkami}}

=== History ===
*The founding period is unknown. Books from the {{ill|Kanbun (era)|Q1146228|qid=Q1146228}} and {{ill|Tenna|Q1145289|qid=Q1145289}} eras of the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}} mention “Shirahige Daimyōjin” and “Shirahige Shrine.”
*{{ill|1874|Q7761|qid=Q7761}} ({{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 7): renamed Shirahige-sha.
*{{ill|1879|Q7783|qid=Q7783}} (Meiji 12): became a village shrine.
*{{ill|1880|Q7806|qid=Q7806}} (Meiji 13): renamed Shirahige Shrine.
*{{ill|1938|Q18645|qid=Q18645}} ({{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 13): relocated to current site due to Sai River improvement works.
*{{ill|1992|Q2060|qid=Q2060}} ({{ill|Heisei era|Q234510|qid=Q234510}} 4): Toyokuni Shrine built as a precinct shrine.

=== Transportation ===
*15 minutes on foot from “Sunomata” bus stop on the Gikaki Line of {{ill|Meihan Kintetsu Bus|Q11415818|qid=Q11415818}}
**From stop 2 at {{ill|Ōgaki Station Bus Terminal|Q11433817|qid=Q11433817}} (south of {{ill|Ōgaki Station|Q871579|qid=Q871579}}), bound for {{ill|Gifu Shotoku Gakuen University|Q5560125|qid=Q5560125}} or Gifu Ryūtsū Center South Gate
*15 minutes on foot from “Sunomata” bus stop on the Obusa-Sunomata line of {{ill|Gifu Bus|Q5560101|qid=Q5560101|lt=Gifu Noriai Jidōsha}}
**From stop 6 at {{ill|JR Gifu Station Bus Terminal|Q11226229|qid=Q11226229}} (north of {{ill|Gifu Station|Q1144885|qid=Q1144885}}), bound for W65 Sunomata
**From stop 1 at {{ill|Meitetsu Gifu Boarding Area|Q11415771|qid=Q11415771}} (west of {{ill|Meitetsu Gifu Station|Q1109902|qid=Q1109902}}), bound for W65 Sunomata
